title: Alignment Collapse Under KV Cache Quantization: Diagnosis and Mitigation
reasoning: The paper investigates the technical phenomenon of 'alignment collapse' where KV cache quantization causes LLMs to stop refusing harmful requests. While it utilizes safety benchmarks like AdvBench and HarmBench, it focuses on the mechanistic and geometric causes of this failure rather than evaluating religious beliefs, moral reasoning frameworks, or ethical dilemmas.
